facts.text: Serve the mains when Frank turns down the free meal at the deli.
facts.why: A summary says Serpico refuses free bagels. No opened source puts a free meal at a deli.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Frank turns down the free bagels.

facts.text: the box on the squad room desk that Frank won't take for free
facts.why: Sources mention refused free bagels, not doughnuts.
facts.fix: the free bagels Frank turns down

facts.text: the free lunch Frank insists on paying for
facts.why: The refused food in the sources is bagels, and no source shows a pastrami lunch.
facts.fix: the free lunch Frank pays for anyway

facts.text: Our store on West 10th, a few doors from the Sixth Precinct.
facts.why: No opened source places Serpico in the Sixth Precinct. His apartment was in Greenwich Village and his early posting was the 81st precinct.
facts.fix: Our store in the Village, a few doors from the station house.

vibe.verdict: A believable Village deli that gets the free food idea, the dog and the opera, but skips the shooting and the inquiry.
missing: Serpico shot in the face and rushed to hospital (the raid)

Opera on the soundtrack, Tosca (the apartment)
